description: This file defines a Perl class for handling blacklist username result sets within the Coocook schema, including methods for adding usernames and checking if a username is okay.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::BlacklistUsername
classes.description: A class representing a result set for blacklisted usernames, extending the base ResultSet class and including methods for managing username blacklists.

methods.name: add_username
methods.description: Adds a username to the blacklist with optional additional column data.

methods.name: is_username_ok
methods.description: Checks if a username is not blacklisted, referencing external component logic.
